title: Joie Grey Releases Powerful New Track "All That Muscle" about the Price of Success
htmlContent:
Joie Grey's latest release, "All That Muscle," is a powerful anthem about the price of success. The contemporary R&B and Pop artist's new track is a passionate and energetic rant about those who forget the people who helped them achieve their goals and become powerful and successful.

Grey's soulful voice and skillful songwriting are on full display in "All That Muscle," which showcases his versatility as an artist. The track is a departure from his previous releases but still maintains his signature sound, blending electronic sounds with modern Pop/R&B rhythms.

Born Jonathan Green in Montgomery, Alabama, Joie Grey learned to play several instruments under the instruction of his Grandmother and Mother, both professional musicians. He released his independently created debut album, ODDyssey, in 2016 and BINARY in May 2018. Since then, he has continued to hone his craft and evolve his sound.

With over 1.5 million streams and 150k monthly listeners on Spotify, Joie Grey's music is resonating with fans worldwide. "All That Muscle" is a powerful addition to his growing discography and a testament to his talent as an artist.
